motor_vehicle_division.overview: Constituent part of the Transport Department, Government of Sikkim. Enforces and implements laws relating to the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989, Sikkim Motor Vehicle Rules, 1991, and the Sikkim Motor Vehicles (Taxation) Act, 1982.
business_functions: Issue of route permits to transport vehicles
Collection of motor vehicle road tax
Collection of Government revenue via fees from vehicle owners
Recommendation of countersignature of permit for Sikkim vehicles in West Bengal
Countersignature of permit to West Bengal public/stage/contract carriages under Reciprocal Transport Agreement
All matters relating to Inter-State Transport Arrangement
Enforcement of Motor Vehicles Act 1988, CMVR 1989, SMVR 1991, and Sikkim MV Taxation Act 1982
Control of all State Transport undertakings

pollution_control.policy: Smoke test mandatory during fitness check. No fitness certificate issued to failing vehicles. Surprise checks by Motor Vehicles officials; PUC certificate demanded; defaulters fined.

road_safety.monitoring_body: Committee on Road Safety, Supreme Court of India (constituted 2012)
actions_taken: Road Safety Committee set up at State and District levels
Lead Agency notified (Police, Health, PWD, HRDD, Roads & Bridges, BRO, NGOs, Local Bodies)
Black Spots identified by Crime Branch, Police Department
Enforcement strengthened for drunken driving, over-speeding, red light jumping, helmet/seat belt
Road patrolling strengthened on National Highways
Traffic calming techniques directed (rumble strips, speed breakers, road signs)
Ban on alcohol sale on State/National Highways enforced
Notification issued for removal of obstructive hoardings
Budget head created for Road Safety in 2015-16
Road Safety Action Plan submitted to MoRTH in February 2015
Action for pedestrian path encroachment removal underway

odd_even_notification.applicable_area: National Highway, Mayfair Fatak to GICI Zero Point, Gangtok Municipal Area

rules.odd_dates: Vehicles with registration number ending in odd digit (1,3,5,7,9) permitted between 9:00–12:30 and 15:30–18:00
rules.even_dates: Vehicles with registration number ending in even digit (0,2,4,6,8) permitted between 9:00–12:30 and 15:30–18:00

exemptions_from_restriction: Feeder roads within Gangtok Municipal area
Indira Bye-Pass and Northern Bye-Pass roads
2nd and 4th Saturdays, Sundays, and Government Holidays
odd_even_notification.penalty_for_violation: As per Section 177 and Section 179(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988
odd_even_notification.signed_by: V. B. Pathak, IAS, Chief Secretary, Government of Sikkim
